t: This is 87 Chancery Lane, a building in the Camden part of London, in the WC2A postcode. It was designed by Arthur Blomfield, an English architect who built a lot of churches. He became president of the Architectural Association in 1861 and was later vice-president of the Royal Institute of British Architects. He was architect to the Bank of England and built its Law Courts branch in 1883. He was knighted, and in 1891 he received the RIBA gold medal. I don't have more detail on the building itself.
